name: polynomial-root-analysis
description: Polynomial Root Analysis — one polynomial and what acts on its roots. Roots and coefficients as two draggable point sets over a phase portrait (Vieta one way, a tracked re-solve the other), with certified Smith inclusion discs; the Galois group over ℚ in three honest tiers (= Sₙ/Aₙ at any degree, = to degree 7 by resolvents, ≈ 8–15 by statistics); loop monodromy by certified continuation, refused by name where a segment cannot be certified; and Arnold's topological proof of Abel–Ruffini as executed commutator loops. Established by ADR-0047 (plan: docs/polynomial-root-analysis/PLAN.md). Not ADR-0046's Polynomial Roots, the root-cloud renderer. PRA-0 is the scaffold: @cas/ui (fatal boundary, accessible canvas) only; @cas/core, @cas/exact, @cas/expr, @cas/gpu, @cas/rigor, @cas/interchange, @cas/export and the new @cas/monodromy join in the milestones that first need them (ADR-0007).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
